name: video-search-app
description: YouTube video search application with yt-dlp support

scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/check-hardcoded-polish.mjs && node scripts/check-tsconfig-strict.mjs
scripts.lint:deps: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs server client chrome-extension shared test-infra
scripts.typecheck: cd server && pnpm run typecheck && cd ../client && pnpm run typecheck && cd ../chrome-extension && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test: cd server && pnpm run test && cd ../client && pnpm run test:run && cd ../chrome-extension && pnpm run test
scripts.test:coverage: cd server && pnpm run test:coverage && cd ../client && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.humanizer:score: node scripts/humanizer/index.js scan README.md AGENTS.md DESIGN.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md RELEASING.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md CHANGELOG.md chrome-extension/README.md chrome-extension/INSTALL.md chrome-extension/icons/README.md .github/pull_request_template.md --ignore-code --ignore-quotes
scripts.humanizer:gate: node scripts/humanizer/index.js scan README.md AGENTS.md DESIGN.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md RELEASING.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md CHANGELOG.md chrome-extension/README.md chrome-extension/INSTALL.md chrome-extension/icons/README.md .github/pull_request_template.md --baseline scripts/humanizer-baseline.json --fail-on-regression --ignore-code --ignore-quotes
